name: ChainSwap MappingToken receive() unauthorised signatories
summary: The bridge's receive(fromChainId,to,nonce,volume,Signature[]) counted the supplied signature entries towards its threshold without checking that each signatory was an authorised bridge signer, so anyone could mint bridged tokens to themselves.

loss.notes: Forty nonzero mint events beginning with the anchored transaction created exactly 20,000,000 WYLD for the attacker. The attacker sold that full amount in transaction 0x6fcc98a9a765ed2fb6992e099a0a13fe65c46901dbbf0401a76c2edb4a70b3e2 for exactly 652.443795985428055167 WBNB, the exact BSC liquidity loss measured by this row.

ageReset.description: ProxyFactory productImplementations('MappingToken') changed from 0xdcb4d17894bd508c0d00b6ddf00ea60e413ef98b to 0xe92998f47118335ba33d1eba87282584f53519b5, the implementation selected by the product proxy at the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit receipt and call trace, product-proxy CREATE2 trace, immutable factory/name selection, transaction-local factory state diffs, runtime code, the complete governor transaction sequence from product-proxy creation through the pre-exploit block, every WYLD mint to the attacker and the liquidation receipt, the commit-pinned reproduction, and ChainSwap's post-mortem. Factory proxy 0xbf515ff38d55737c56d62e8b6a8eea322ec38aa5 reports the same code-empty governor 0xc96ecc8456cd0e5b20c1c40989adad9c1809da9c throughout the interval. Enumerating every governor nonce transition shows four upgradeProductImplementationsTo_ calls and the MappingToken slot sequence 0x860da66ce2962233112d5f738bec5f14d865e690, zero, 0xfcb095931a0d35c373dbba06c722b639f2c4abee, 0xdcb4d17894bd508c0d00b6ddf00ea60e413ef98b, then 0xe92998f47118335ba33d1eba87282584f53519b5. Transaction 0x43b731b02f393fdb676e34a221a98d0b2a0d885299f03e04ad6e4f7380b23ada performs the final slot write, and the governor's only later pre-exploit transaction targets another contract. The exploit calls product proxy 0x089165ac9a7bf61833da86268f34a01652543466 and delegates to the 14,363-byte final implementation with hash 0xedf8e137d8c2dc68f17bef8162d8b9ed234fa14b099a120feb8baf235d782d90. Forty nonzero mint events create exactly 20,000,000 WYLD for the attacker, whose single sale receives exactly 652.443795985428055167 WBNB.

limitations: The 652.443795985428055167 WBNB loss was realized by the liquidation transaction 5,388 seconds after the first mint anchor; its USD value uses CoinGecko's nearest pre-anchor WBNB price.
